about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of Erwin, a witch hunter, in this story-driven visual novel. Navigate a world of magic, suspicion, and quirky characters, where your choices—especially in conversations—shape your relationships.

Your interactions with Raven, your co-worker, are key: you can influence her thoughts, charm, deceive, or even test her trust. Other characters can be approached similarly, letting you build connections and explore different sides of the story.

With a mix of humor, emotional moments, and catchy storytelling, the game delivers an engaging narrative experience, even with its smaller scope. While the consequences aren’t world-changing, the decisions you make affect friendships, trust, and how the story unfolds.

Key features:

  • Interactive dialogue: Shape Erwin’s relationships through conversation choices.

  • Character-driven narrative: Meet memorable personalities with their own quirks and secrets.

  • Fantasy world: Explore a magical setting full of intrigue and charm.

  • Humor & emotion: Experience lighthearted moments and touching story beats throughout the journey.

Whether you’re building trust, testing loyalties, or navigating playful moral dilemmas, every conversation is an opportunity to shape Erwin’s story.

short_description: Play as Erwin, a witch hunter navigating a fantasy world of magic and suspicion. Your decisions in this visual novel affect friendships, trust, and multiple story outcomes. Choose wisely—the fate of your journey rests with you.
